about: The engine's art library (R-ASSET-05): the Offset Planes system. Flat greyscale geometry on a dark ground, recoloured to each site's brand and accent hues at build time by engine/tools/lib/art.js. composition: quiet = the start 40 % one empty dark field, for text; field = structure across the frame; calm = almost empty, for text-heavy cards (used only when declared). crop: the sharp position kept when a piece is cropped to another ratio. inverted: the source was drawn on a light ground and inverted on import so every piece sits on a dark one. Generated with OpenAI's image model through the Codex CLI on 2026-10-22 from the shared prompt plus each piece's subject (the system proposed by Codex, refined with Grok's critique), then reviewed.
model: OpenAI image generation via Codex CLI 0.163.0
prompt: Create a premium abstract corporate graphic in the "Offset Planes" system. Landscape 16:9. Flat vector-like geometry only: rectangles, parallelograms, quarter-discs and broad bands; horizontal, vertical or 45-degree edges. Use only five opaque greys: #141414, #474747, #808080, #B8B8B8, #F0F0F0. Include light, middle and dark values. Align shapes to a 12-column, 8-row grid with half-module offsets. Use 5-9 large shapes unless the subject requests fewer; minimum band or gap width 1.5% of canvas width. Keep essential relationships within x32-68%, y20-80%; secondary shapes may bleed. Suggest depth only through crisp overlap, maximum two layers. Refinement rule: beside each major plane run one or two narrow parallel offset channels (0.5-0.8% of canvas width) in a lighter grey, like precise lines of light separating layers, and use three scales of offset in every image (micro channels, medium shifts, one large displacement). The background is always the darkest grey. No outlines, gradients, texture, noise, shadows, perspective, photography, 3D, text, symbols, people or recognisable objects. Never let shapes form letters, digits, arrows, pipes, logos or icon-like silhouettes. Restrained editorial design; purposeful negative space. Perfectly flat fills, crisp edges.
